scope_now: source-free training-readiness code and tests; no actual fitting
prefix_features: 60 clipped normalized summaries + 11 inner-train-threshold prefix-state indicators + 2 unclipped normalized log1p prefix moments
generator: shared latent mixture; separately predicted future initial-mask logits; per-block binary transition rows; per-channel zero-sum block contrast; per-channel scale; future level integrated out in projected contrast likelihood
loss: mean9queryBCE +0.1*negative joint mask/projected-centered-path mixture loglikelihood /46; person macro weighting in future runner
stopping: fixed epochs, no held-source stopping or best-epoch selection; budget/NaN/integrity failures preserved
source_folds: existing source34 people/1442 recordings,3folds; historically exposed exploratory
primary_score: participant-macro mean9query clipped log loss, include invalid15rows; same source folds/threshold provenance as prior baseline
promotion_screen: at least2percent lower primary score than strongest Markov/HGB baseline and improvement in at least2of3folds; exploratory only; all controls/failures reported
baseline_recheck: future runner must match saved source Markov/HGB evaluation with inner-train preprocessing before new comparative claims
path_label_normalization: inner-train pooled within-record contrast scale; no between-note level variance; future centering is labels only, never inference input
invariance_scope: auxiliary target likelihood conditional on fixed future mask is invariant to per-record per-channel constant shifts; not a claim of raw audio or network-input invariance
